companyDescription: Defense drone + industrial robotics · Palantir-backed · Autonomous drone systems for U.S. DoD, rail & energy sectors — Q1 revenue +1,065% YoY
priceNote: Pulled back from $15 high · Q2-to-date orders $150M+ — strongest order intake in company history
summary: Ondas is a Palantir-backed defense drone & industrial automation play printing explosive revenue growth (+1,065% YoY in Q1) via its Cyberhawk drone-as-a-service acquisition and AIROBOTICS military drone unit. With $150M+ in Q2-to-date orders and Eurosatory 2026 launch, the thesis is a DoD drone contract scale-up turning a $4.5B market cap into a $20B+ defense drone prime. Binary risk: dilution and margin execution. Position max 3–5% of portfolio — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50–70%.

catalysts.name: Q2 Order Momentum — $150M+
catalysts.description: $40M+ new orders announced Jun 23 (Counter-UAS, Loitering Munition). Q2-to-date orders hit $150M+, driven by Eurosatory 2026 launch of LADOS C2 system. Revenue recognition follows in Q3.

risks: Dilution risk — frequent equity raises to fund growth; share count could expand 20–30%
Revenue recognition lag — large order intake doesn't equal immediate cash; execution matters
DoD contract concentration — losing a key contract = 30–50% revenue hit
Competition from AeroVironment, Joby Aviation, DroneShield in defense drone space
Margin structure unclear — Cyberhawk drone-as-a-service has different margins than product sales

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Defense spending is rate-insensitive — DoD budgets are appropriated regardless of Fed policy. ONDS revenues driven by government contracts, not consumer credit.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Mild positive — inflation = higher defense budgets in nominal terms. Drone-as-a-service pricing can be adjusted.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Defense tech outperforms in high-rate environment. Autonomous systems are bipartisan priority — insulated from policy swings.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk LOW — defense drone revenue is government-contracted, not rate-sensitive. Macro tailwinds strong with NATO/DoD autonomous drone push.
